title: Optimise image loading
description: Review source sizes, responsive candidates, dimensions, decoding and loading priority.
accomplishes: Review source sizes, responsive candidates, dimensions, decoding and loading priority. Lazy-load noncritical imagery without delaying important content. Preserve meaningful alternative text and compare actual transfer and layout behaviour before claiming an improvement.
prompt:
Act as a web developer.

Task: Optimise image loading.

Input context:
- PAGE: [PAGE]
- IMAGE INVENTORY: [IMAGE INVENTORY]
- LAYOUT: [LAYOUT]
- MEASUREMENTS: [MEASUREMENTS]

Review source sizes, responsive candidates, dimensions, decoding and loading priority. Lazy-load noncritical imagery without delaying important content. Preserve meaningful alternative text and compare actual transfer and layout behaviour before claiming an improvement.

Preserve the existing architecture, minimise dependencies and define scope, acceptance criteria and relevant tests. Keep secrets server-side. No production changes or deployment without approval.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Resource-card image plan
Provide appropriately sized sources, reserve dimensions and defer images below the initial viewport. Keep the primary content image eligible for timely loading. Verify cropping, alternative text and layout stability on narrow screens. Proposed byte reductions remain estimates until measured with comparable cache and device conditions.
